probe_detail.name: Uses numbered or bulleted list structure
Identifies the actual error in the asker's approach
Justifies the step a reader is most likely to doubt

final.name: Socratic Prompting and Interactivity
final.audit_justification: Whether an answer leaves an exercise for the asker versus spoon-feeds is a pedagogical delivery style, not evidence about the correctness or substance of the solution, though genuinely engaged teachers may also write more careful answers.
final.arbiter_reason: The instruction scores a pedagogical delivery convention -- whether work is left for the asker versus handed over -- so a 10 is evidence about how the solution is packaged, not about whether the mathematics is right, complete, or responsive to the question. Mixed because answerers who deliberately scaffold are plausibly more engaged with the asker's actual difficulty and may write better solutions for that reason.

final.name: Total verbosity and length
final.audit_justification: Raw length/verbosity is a classic incidental surface feature, though genuinely more thorough answers may also tend to run longer.
final.upstream_parent: author's verbosity and desire to be comprehensive

final.name: Personal voice: sign-offs, exclamations, emoticons, flourishes
final.audit_justification: Sign-offs, emoticons, and exclamatory flourishes are personal-voice typography with no plausible link to the substantive correctness or completeness of the math.
final.upstream_parent: the answerer's persona and register habits (age, community role, self-presentation style) rather than anything about the question

final.name: Useful generalization
final.audit_justification: Whether a derived generalization is genuinely useful and well-supported versus unrelated filler speaks directly to the substantive value of the content.

final.name: Custom TeX macro preamble and heavy display-math apparatus
final.audit_justification: Macro preambles and heavy display apparatus are explicitly scored as markup presence regardless of whether the math is right, though power-user typesetting habits may track more experienced, generally careful authors.
final.upstream_parent: the answerer's accumulated practice and standing on the site (a long-time regular fluent in the site's MathJax dialect versus an occasional or first-time poster)

final.name: Returns the exact object the question asked for, in the asked format
final.audit_justification: Whether the answer actually terminates on the exact requested object versus leaves it implicit is direct evidence of whether the question was actually answered.

final.name: Density of external citations and tool references
final.audit_justification: The criterion scores only the amount of citation/tool-reference apparatus present, explicitly not its relevance or accuracy, though a habit of citing tools may accompany genuinely more verified work.
final.upstream_parent: author's access to literature/computational tools and research practice in this answering format

final.name: Excessive Meta-Commentary or Apologies
final.audit_justification: This scores a rhetorical register (apologetic disclaimers about the post itself) rather than the mathematical substance, though an apologetic tone may sometimes track genuinely less confident or thinner content.
final.arbiter_reason: This scores boilerplate and rhetorical register (disclaimers, apologies, meta-talk about the post) rather than the mathematical content, and a judge applying it would be counting prefatory formulae; the one substantive case it catches, an explicit 'this is not an answer', is incidental to the instruction as written. Mixed because habitual hedging plausibly co-occurs with genuinely thinner or less certain mathematics.

final.name: Scope discipline: answers what was asked
final.audit_justification: Whether the response stays on the substance of what was asked versus wanders into unrequested digressions bears on the actual content delivered, not just its packaging.

final.name: Ambiguity handling
final.audit_justification: Explicitly noticing and stating an interpretation of an ambiguous question is substantive evidence of careful, correct engagement with the actual problem.

final.name: Conceptual bridge before formalism
final.audit_justification: Explaining why a technique applies and connecting symbols to underlying ideas is squarely about the explanatory substance of the answer.

final.name: Edge-case completeness
final.audit_justification: Systematic handling of boundary cases versus an overclaimed general result is direct evidence of mathematical rigor and completeness.

final.name: Internal consistency audit
final.audit_justification: Internal consistency of notation, signs, and conclusions is a direct correctness signal about the content itself.

final.name: Sanity-check discipline
final.audit_justification: Checking domains, convergence, and plausibility is substantive verification behavior bearing on whether the answer is actually right.

final.name: Supportive and patient register
final.audit_justification: Warmth versus coldness of tone is a register/voice marker rather than evidence about the mathematical substance, though patient authors may also be more generally careful.
final.arbiter_reason: Warmth versus coldness is a tone/community-style marker: an answer can be maximally patient and mathematically wrong, or curt and fully correct, so a high score is not evidence about substance even though it predicts acceptance. Mixed because a patient disposition plausibly travels with more careful and complete exposition.

final.name: Markup and display conventions
final.audit_justification: This explicitly scores formatting/markup presence only, not whether the presentation is good, so it is a typographic surface feature, though it may co-occur with more practiced, careful authorship.
final.upstream_parent: author's practice in the site's formatting system

final.name: Flat declarative terseness versus visible hedging
final.audit_justification: The criterion explicitly scores only declarative-versus-hedging register, not whether the confidence is warranted, though unhedged terseness could sometimes track authors who actually know the result is correct.
final.upstream_parent: the answerer's practice and seniority in this format (a practised regular's willingness to be terse and flatly declarative)

final.name: Register matched to the asker's evident level
final.audit_justification: Whether the machinery deployed is pitched to what this asker's question shows they can use is a substantive fit-to-need judgment, not a surface style marker.

final.name: Affirmation of correct work before correction
final.audit_justification: Leading with affirmation before correction is an etiquette/ordering convention rather than evidence about the correctness of the math, though it may accompany more careful, thorough diagnosis overall.
final.arbiter_reason: The instruction scores an etiquette and ordering convention -- affirmation placed before correction -- and can be satisfied by a vacuous 'your work looks fine' without any accurate diagnosis, so it measures presentation order rather than the quality of the correction. Mixed because genuinely diagnosing which steps were right often requires real engagement with the asker's work, which co-produces better answers.

final.name: Era-marked conventions
final.audit_justification: This is explicitly a period/era fingerprint of notation and convention, a temporal tell with no bearing on the substantive quality of the answer.

final.name: Proportionate method
final.audit_justification: Whether the method's complexity is well-matched to the difficulty of the problem is a substantive judgment about the quality of the mathematical approach.

final.name: Reply-position framing
final.audit_justification: Presupposing earlier answers or discussion is a structural artifact of an item's position in the thread, explicitly scored without regard to whether that framing is good or correct.

final.name: Second-person coaching addressed at the asker
final.audit_justification: The criterion explicitly scores only how much second-person address is present, not whether it is helpful, making it a register marker, though personalized coaching may sometimes accompany more tailored, substantive help.
final.upstream_parent: the answerer's conception of their audience (this asker versus future searchers)

final.name: Elegance via Trivial Counterexample
final.audit_justification: Preferring a simple, immediate counterexample over a convoluted argument reflects genuine mathematical insight and parsimony rather than a surface style tell.

final.name: Future-reader framing
final.audit_justification: This scores the mere presence of future-reader-oriented apparatus like caveats and references, explicitly not their usefulness, though more archival, thorough authors may also write genuinely better answers.
